validation_status: WSL PHASE 2A COMPLETE — 4 VERIFIED repos. Meets pre-reg ≥4 floor. Linux/WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04 + Node 24.11.1 (nvm) + Python 3.12.3 (uv venvs) + yarn 4.15 + pnpm 10.12 (corepack) is the locked execution environment. Per-PR reproducibility (box 4c proper) still pending — gate for that is candidate-pool.json freshness for the current VERIFIED set.
selection_criteria_summary: Public GitHub; permissive license (MIT / Apache-2.0 / BSD-3 / ISC); ≥30 bug-fix PRs in last 24 months; reproducible test command ≤5 min on warm cache; 50-2000 source files (excluding tests/vendor/node_modules); last commit ≤6 months old; primary language TypeScript / JavaScript / Python.
selection_principle: Span ≥2 of {TS, JS, Py} and ≥2 size buckets; favor fast deterministic local tests; avoid huge / slow / infra-heavy repos.

execution_environment.python_envs: uv venvs (uv 0.11.16, sudo-less; PEP 668 + missing python3-venv apt package blocked system pip)
execution_environment.rationale: Phase 2A on native Windows yielded only 3/6 OK after two iterations of fixes (see bench-results/internal-diagnostics/file-memory-real-repos-windows-environment.md). WSL2 Ubuntu 24.04 gave same 3 + recovered zod via replacement → 4 OK, meeting pre-reg floor.

diversity_note: After 3rd amendment: TS x1 (zod), JS x1 (mathjs), Py x2 (black, rich). Pre-reg criterion 'span ≥2 of {TS, JS, Py}' satisfied with 3 languages. Size buckets: small x3 (rich 144, zod 197, black 59), medium x1 (mathjs 684). No large bucket. werkzeug at 106 Py would have added another small but was excluded for test-suite runtime > 5min.
